channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Alckmin: Desafio é convencer quem não votou a comparecer no 2º turno
item.description: Vice-president Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) emphasized that Lula's main challenge in the second round is mobilizing voters who did not participate in the first stage. He stressed the importance of encouraging turnout to ensure victory.

item.title: Ratinho Junior anuncia apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Vamos caminhar juntos'
item.description: The governor of Paraná, Ratinho Junior (PSD), announced support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the presidential runoff against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). The alliance aims to strengthen the conservative base of the PL candidate.

item.title: Voto de Flávio e aliados contra o fim da 6x1 será um presente a Lula
item.description: Senators allied to Flávio D'Avila will vote against ending the 6x1 work schedule, a stance that indirectly benefits Lula's government by undermining labor flexibility agenda. The vote is scheduled for this Wednesday at the Senate plenary session, following pressure from unions and social movements. The lawmakers' stance reflects alignment with progressive sectors and electoral strategies for 2026.

item.title: TSE questiona Meta depois de campanha de Lula apontar ‘interferência’ nas eleições
item.description: The Brazilian Superior Electoral Court (TSE) requested clarifications from Meta following accusations by Lula's campaign that social media content restrictions reduced the president's reach ahead of the October 25 runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro. Meta denied the claims, calling them false and asserting compliance with Brazilian election regulations.

item.title: Gastos: no Brasil em transe, ou Flávio mente aos pobres ou “auzmercáduz”
item.description: The text analyzes Flávio Bolsonaro's spending cut promises, highlighting criticism about how the cuts could negatively impact low-income citizens, and compares his stance with historical figures from Brazilian cinema such as the red senator in 'Terra em Transe'.

item.title: Ratinho Junior anuncia apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘Vamos caminhar juntos’
item.description: Paraná governor Ratinho Junior (PSD) endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for the presidential runoff. The move follows the elimination of his candidate, Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), in the first round. Other defeated candidates also supported Flávio, consolidating strength against Lula in the second round.

item.title: Lula faz comício em Natal e Flávio participa de moto-carreata no Rio
item.description: Lula held a packed rally in Natal, highlighting social investments in the Northeast and criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro's proposed cuts. Flávio participated in a motorcycle caravan in Rio, promoting a right-wing agenda. Both face security concerns and disinformation during the campaign.

item.title: Cleitinho se explica após críticas por vídeo com Alcolumbre: "Não apoiei"
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo defended himself against criticism after a video with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, claiming he does not support him and that the meeting aims to approve the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule.

item.title: Flávio exalta Bolsonaro e vê culto falar de voto; Lula mira gasolina subsidiada e tesouraço de rival
item.description: On the first Saturday of the 2026 runoff election, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) praised his father, Jair Bolsonaro, during a caravan in Rio de Janeiro, while Lula (PT) supported government measures to control gasoline prices in Natal. The events took place 15 days before the vote, scheduled for October 25.

item.title: Léo Jardim lamenta empate do Vasco, mas vira a chave para decisão na Sul-Americana: “Foco total”
item.description: Léo Jardim regretted Vasco's goalless draw against Remo in the Brazilian league but emphasized focus on the crucial South American final against Boca Juniors. He highlighted fan support and the need to move forward quickly for the match in Argentina.

item.title: Acordão? Jair Bolsonaro solto, Flávio livre de Master e INSS e Moraes ‘esquecido’
item.description: Speculation grows about a potential Supreme Court deal to benefit both Minister Alexandre de Moraes and the Bolsonaro brothers, involving rulings on investigations and controversial contracts. The scenario hints at strategic alliances and Michel Temer's influence, with direct implications for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala em “guerra espiritual” durante culto no Rio
item.description: At a centennial service of the Assembleia de Deus church in Rio, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro declared that Brazil faces a 'spiritual war' and criticized opponents using lies to mislead the public. He emphasized his belief in a divine plan for the nation and referred to Douglas Ruas as the officially declared governor of Rio.

item.title: Ratinho Jr. declara apoio a Flávio: “Vamos caminhar juntos”
item.description: The governor of Paraná, Ratinho Jr. (PSD), declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the presidential runoff. The announcement was made after a conversation with Senator Flávio and the governor of São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas.

item.title: Justiça italiana marca novo julgamento sobre extradição de Carla Zambelli
item.description: The Italian judiciary has set a new hearing for October 29 to reassess the extradition request of former federal lawmaker Carla Zambelli, convicted in Brazil for illegal weapons possession and assault. Italy dismissed claims of political persecution but demanded more guarantees about medical care in Brazil. The trial will not reassess the Brazilian conviction, only whether the extradition request meets legal and international treaty requirements.

item.title: Ratinho Junior anuncia apoio a Flávio no 2º turno: "Vamos caminhar juntos"
item.description: The governor of Paraná, Ratinho Junior (PSD), announced support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the second round of the presidential election, emphasizing a partnership with the governor of São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas. This move follows the endorsement of ally Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), who is supporting Flávio against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).

item.title: Lula transforma “entrega” em mote e cobra Flávio sobre Vorcaro
item.description: Lula launches a new electoral ad for the second round centered on the theme 'delivering,' accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of wanting to hand Brazil over to the US and linking him to Daniel Vorcaro and Banco Master. The campaign highlights achievements such as Pé-de-Meia, income tax exemption up to R$5,000, and the taxation of the wealthy, juxtaposed with criticisms of a 'biased scale' and Flávio's betting activities.

item.title: "Exército do Lula": Flávio pede ao TSE suspensão do canal de Janones
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro requested the TSE to suspend the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel created by André Janones, accusing abuse of power and improper use of media. The group, with 3.2 million members, became the target of legal action for alleged electoral violations. Janones denied the allegations and called on supporters to mobilize to prevent the channel's suspension.

item.title: Emails indicam que Flávio dividia conta com investigado na fraude do INSS
item.description: E-mails seized by PF suggest that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro may have shared a bank account with lawyer Willer Tomaz, who is under investigation for money laundering linked to INSS fraud. The correspondence includes a request to remove Flávio's name from the account associated with the lawyer.

item.title: Jornalista argentina pede que Brasil não eleja Flávio: “Terror”
item.description: Argentine journalist Nancy Pazos warned that a victory by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in the Brazilian presidential elections would result in a 'horror movie', comparing a potential right-wing government in Brazil to Javier Milei's administration in Argentina. During the 'Inteligencia Artesanal' program, Pazos highlighted economic crises, unemployment, and criticism of the economy minister, urging Brazilians not to vote for the right-wing candidate.

item.title: Rodrigo Fagundes fala sobre eleição e a nova etapa de seu personagem
item.description: Rodrigo Fagundes discussed in an interview the new phase of his character Nicolau in Quem Ama Cuida and emphasized the importance of Brazilian cinema. He also addressed the 2026 elections, stating he will vote for Lula and advocating for respectful dialogue among supporters of opposing views.

item.title: Saiba quem é Douglas Ruas, eleito governador do RJ após decisão do TSE
item.description: Douglas Ruas (PL), 37, was elected governor of Rio de Janeiro in the first round after the TSE annulled Anthony Garotinho's votes. With 50.88% of valid votes, Ruas, a police officer and son of Captain Nelson Ruas, will take office with Vice-Governor Fernanda Louback. His government plan prioritizes public security with the Escudo Fluminense and includes proposals in health, education, and expansion of the military police force.

item.title: Jair Bolsonaro vai indicar ministros se Flávio vencer eleições, diz Eduardo
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro stated that Jair Bolsonaro would influence ministerial appointments if Flávio Bolsonaro wins the 2026 elections. The statement was made during an interview with SBT News, highlighting the former president's potential role in shaping a PL government.

item.title: Eduardo diz que buscará sanção dos EUA a Moraes se Flávio Bolsonaro vencer
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro said he will push for the reinstatement of U.S. sanctions against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes if his brother Flávio Bolsonaro wins the 2026 election. He emphasized his active role in the race against President Lula, focusing on foreign policy and security.

item.title: Flávio fala em “guerra espiritual” e recebe apoio de bispo em culto
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, stated during a service at Maracanãzinho in Rio de Janeiro that Brazil is facing a 'spiritual war.' At the celebration of the 100th anniversary of the Assembleia de Deus Ministério de Madureira, Bishop Samuel Ferreira praised the senator and announced he would request votes for him. The speech highlighted religion as a central campaign theme.

item.title: E-mails indicam que Flávio dividiu conta bancária com advogado investigado na fraude do INSS
item.description: Emails suggest senator Flávio Bolsonaro and lawyer Willer Tomaz shared a bank account after investigations into the Sem Desconto Operation, which probes INSS fraud. The suspicion arose from messages by a Tomaz employee, but both deny any connection. The Federal Police is investigating Tomaz as a suspected financial hub in a R$6.3 billion Social Security scam.

item.title: Sidônio tira férias da Secom para se dedicar à campanha de Lula
item.description: Sidônio Palmeira, Ministry of Communications chief, will take a leave to focus on Lula's reelection campaign following the first round of 2026 polls. The PT campaign restructures with new coordinators including Camilo Santana and Rui Costa, amid internal criticism after the electoral results.

item.title: Ratinho Jr anuncia apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no segundo turno: 'Vamos caminhar juntos pelo futuro do nosso Brasil'
item.description: Ratinho Jr (PSD) endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro for the runoff, strengthening center-right alliances. Flávio leads polls against Lula, backed by parties like Republicanos, Novo, and Podemos.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro acerta apoio de Ratinho Jr à sua candidatura
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) secured the support of Ratinho Jr (PSD), governor of Paraná, for his presidential candidacy, with an official announcement coming in the next few days. The PSD maintains a neutral stance in the second phase of the elections, but the governor's decision also covers state races with a runoff on October 25th. Ratinho Jr had been mentioned as a potential presidential candidate but withdrew for personal reasons.

item.title: Com Ruas eleito no RJ, cinco estados e DF terão 2º turno para governador
item.description: The TSE annulled votes for Garotinho in RJ, securing Douglas Ruas' first-round election win. As a result, six states and the Federal District will hold gubernatorial runoffs on October 25, the same date as the presidential race between Lula and Bolsonaro.

item.title: Brasil bate a Argentina no Beira-Rio; veja as notas das jogadoras
item.description: The Brazilian women's national team defeated Argentina 3-1 in a friendly match at Beira-Rio, with goals from Luane, Geyse, and Angelina. Luany and Isa Haas stood out positively, while Luana Soares and Bruninha had less impactful performances. Individual ratings reflected each player's contribution during the game.

item.title: Com golaços e domínio do jogo, Seleção Brasileira Feminina vence a Argentina em amistoso; veja os gols
item.description: The Brazilian Women's National Team defeated Argentina 3-1 in a friendly match at Beira-Rio, with goals from Luany, Geyse, and Angelina. The game served as preparation for the 2027 Women's World Cup, which will be hosted by Brazil. Head coach Arthur Elias was suspended, and the match was overseen by assistant Rodrigo Iglesias.

item.title: Ex-Zorra Total e miss: saiba quem é Fernanda Louback, vice de Ruas
item.description: Fernanda Louback, former TV Globo actress and Miss Rio winner, becomes Rio's vice-governor alongside Douglas Ruas after a political career marked by conservative stances, Bolsonaro family alliances and Chamber controversies.

item.title: Campanha de Lula cita interferência da Meta nas eleições e empresa diz que acusação é falsa
item.description: Lula's campaign accused Meta of limiting content reach on its platforms during the election, but the company denied the claims. The PT alleged blocked promotions and search removals on Instagram, filing a complaint with the TSE. Meta stated the allegations are false and affirmed compliance with electoral rules.

item.title: Em evento evangélico, Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Brasil enfrenta ‘guerra espiritual’
item.description: At an event celebrating the 100th anniversary of the Assembleia de Deus do Ministério de Madureira, Flávio Bolsonaro claimed Brazil is experiencing a 'spiritual war' and that his campaign is part of God's plan. Religious leaders in attendance, including Bishop Samuel Ferreira, expressed support for the senator, while denying explicit vote requests.

item.title: “Grande teatro eleitoral”, diz Padilha sobre áudio de Vorcaro
item.description: Minister of Health Alexandre Padilha dismissed an audio attributed to Daniel Vorcaro claiming a R$30 million payment for a Lula documentary as a 'farce'. He accused Flávio Bolsonaro of receiving funds from Vorcaro and labeled him a 'serial liar', framing it as 'electoral theater'.

item.title: Flávio vai a culto com Douglas Ruas e fala em “guerra espiritual” no Brasil
item.description: Flávio vai a culto com Douglas Ruas e fala em “guerra espiritual” no Brasil

item.title: TSE questiona Meta sobre restrições a conteúdos da campanha de Lula
item.description: TSE deputy minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze questioned Meta over alleged restrictions on Lula's campaign content, raising suspicions of favoritism toward Flávio Bolsonaro. The campaign submitted technical reports indicating unequal treatment on social media. The court ordered Meta to provide detailed information on moderation, metrics, and recommendation criteria within 48 hours.

item.title: O hacker que tirou o sono do TSE no primeiro turno
item.description: During the first round of elections, the TSE faced around 40,000 attacks, mostly DDoS attempts, but ruled out coordinated action by Azael or foreign interference after a system outage in vote reporting. The incident was attributed to system overload caused by the high volume of real-time data.

item.title: Lindbergh pede à PF que inclua Flávio em investigação de fraude no INSS
item.description: Federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a crime report with the Federal Police requesting the inclusion of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in investigations into INSS fraud, also asking for a breach of his bank and tax secrecy.

item.title: Campanha de Lula rejeita ‘limpa’ em cargos do Centrão
item.description: Lula's campaign, led by Camilo Santana, rejected firing officials from centrist parties supporting Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff, prioritizing governability and dialogue with dissidents. Minister José Guimarães advocates for cuts, but the PT strategy emphasizes differentiating platforms and securing sectoral backing.

item.title: Risco país cai para 110 pontos, menor nível desde 2020
item.description: Brazil's sovereign risk premium fell to 110 basis points, its lowest since February 2020, driven by market expectations of fiscal discipline under a potential Flávio Bolsonaro administration following the first round of the 2026 elections. The indicator approached Mexico's level, which holds an investment-grade rating, while Brazil remains in the speculative grade.

item.title: Douglas Ruas é confirmado governador eleito do Rio
item.description: Douglas Ruas (PL) was confirmed as the elected governor of Rio de Janeiro after the judiciary recalculated votes and excluded those of Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos), annulled by the TSE. With 50.88% of valid votes, Ruas secured victory in the first round, ending a tight race.

item.title: Governo federal aciona programa de proteção para Ana Elisa após ameaças
item.description: The Ministry of Human Rights and Citizenship activated the State Protection Program of Minas Gerais to ensure the safety of elected federal deputy Ana Elisa (PT-MG) following threats of death and rape. The measure includes joint action by federal and state teams, as well as the involvement of the Federal Police to investigate the threats on social media.

item.title: Lula desafia Flávio a dizer o que estará no corte de R$ 250 bilhões
item.description: Lula challenges Flávio Bolsonaro to detail the R$250 billion spending cut, questioning if it will affect social policies. Flávio's team studies measures like replacing the fiscal framework and revoking administrative acts.

item.title: Sidônio tira férias do governo para se dedicar exclusivamente à campanha de Lula no segundo turno
item.description: Sidônio Palmeira, head of Secom, will take leave to focus exclusively on Lula's re-election campaign in the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro. The move follows internal criticism of the PT's strategy after the first round, where Flávio led with 47.03% against Lula's 45.16%. The campaign will intensify attacks on the opponent, highlighting risks to social programs and labor rights.

item.title: Vitória de Doulgas Ruas é confirmada pelo TRE após retotalização dos votos
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro Regional Electoral Court (TRE-RJ) confirmed Douglas Ruas (PL) as the winner of the gubernatorial race following the recount of valid votes, raising his share from 49.27% to 50.88% and eliminating the need for a runoff. The ruling followed the annulment of 274,411 votes for Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos), convicted of administrative misconduct, leaving only Ruas and Eduardo Paes (PSD) as viable candidates. Paes publicly acknowledged the judicial decision, underscoring respect for democratic institutions.

item.title: Votos de Garotinho são anulados e Douglas Ruas é eleito no 1º turno no RJ
item.description: The TSE-RJ conducted a recount of votes for governor in Rio de Janeiro, confirming Douglas Ruas (PL) as the winner in the first round. The annulment of 274,411 votes for Anthony Garotinho, decided by the TSE, raised Ruas's share from 49.27% to 50.88%, exceeding the absolute majority threshold. Eduardo Paes (PSD), who led the race, withdrew his appeal and acknowledged Ruas's victory.

item.title: Flávio diz que vai receber faixa presidencial de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that if elected president, he will receive the presidential sash from his father, Jair Bolsonaro, who is imprisoned for attempted coup d'état. During a motorcycle rally in São Gonçalo (RJ), Flávio also announced proposals such as declaring war on drug trafficking, increasing punishment for cell phone thieves, and reducing the age of criminal responsibility.

item.title: Campanhas de Flávio e Lula planejam gesto político em dia de Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: The campaign teams of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are planning symbolic political gestures on October 12, the feast day of Our Lady of Aparecida, following a fake news story falsely linking the PL candidate to removing her title as patron saint of Brazil. While Flávio avoids visiting Aparecida and takes a more discreet stance, Lula is expected to leverage the date with religious backing. The Catholic Church has entered the race by criticizing the political exploitation of Marian devotion.

item.title: Hugo Calderano derrota Félix Lebrun e avança para semifinal do China Smash
item.description: Hugo Calderano defeated Félix Lebrun 4-1 and advanced to the China Smash semifinals in Beijing. The Brazilian player will face Taiwan's Lin Yun-ju in the next round. Throughout the tournament, Calderano eliminated four opponents, including the French player who took his bronze medal at the 2024 Olympics.
